- [x] Have you successfully run `brew tests` with your changes locally?

-----

When `safe_fork` fails due to application termination rather than exist, `exitstatus` will be nil. Instead we should pass more of the object, as it has other methods like `termsig` for those cases. When you pass `ErrorDuringExecution` a `Process::Status` object, it will handle that and provide proper information on the failure, rather than choking because the passed exit status is nil.

It is unfortunately impossible to create a `Process::Status` object without using `Marshal.load`. There is no security risk though as this isn't user input.

Fixes #10661.

comments:
There's something wrong with your `/usr/bin/unzip` that's causing it to crash.

There is a `brew` bug here however in the way it is reporting the error.

(Note to other maintainers: we should be marshalling the entire `Process::Status` object in `safe_fork`, not just passing `exitstatus` - I have a fix locally, though `rubocop` doesn't like it.)
Installing heroku cli, getting this error "Status neither has `exitstatus` nor `termsig`" on Big Sur 11.2.1 (20D74)

I'm getting the error fixed - but there is still a genuine error behind it. It should be reading something like:

```
ErrorDuringExecution (Failure while executing; [something] was terminated by uncaught signal [something].)
```

You can maybe look into what was the last thing it did before throwing the error - it's likely that binary/whatever is broken and is crashing.

review_comments: Looking at this again, I think an early `raise` for a nil `status` seems appropriate.
